      "observations": [
        "Read all 475 lines of the exact 18-path owned diff, including every caller/test/API/C++ hunk. The implementation formerly in base dropCard moves into addCard(card,withNewUID); the delegating base addCard and dropCard IDL entry are removed. The IDL documents the optional flag as a fresh-UID choice, and C++ implementations/importers receive the new argument explicitly.",
        "The base chooses lazy.newUID when withNewUID is truthy and retains card.UID otherwise, copies saved properties, clears foreign _etag/_href, clears cache and returns/notifies the stored card. The accepted code later splits public read-only guard from addCardInternal; that later split is the separate 4416 phase.",
        "CardDAV's upload interception moves from dropCard to addCard and remains synchronous local return plus separately caught upload promise. Sync's qualified super.addCard now reaches the local base implementation without the old delegating method's dynamic this.dropCard call. Bulk sync and server-UID replacement keep qualified local writes. This does not prove remote upload success when addCard returns.",
        "Mailing-list addCard now handles the fresh-UID copy through its parent before adding membership and returning the actual card. It still returns early for no primary email. The separate old dropCard wrapper, which called addCard and notified again, is removed; no new mailing-list event-count assertion is added in this patch.",
        "Drag/drop copies pass true; drag moves omit the flag and delete the old cards afterward. The contact panel deliberately still requests a new UID even when changing books, then deletes the original. Reuse that focused earlier move/caching lesson rather than treating every user-visible move as the same UID policy.",
        "Copy tests replace two dropCard calls with addCard(...,true), while existing move cases use addCard without the flag. Actual assertions distinguish changed/preserved UID and check serialized vCard values plus destination metadata after a contact-updated notification. Some immediate metadata checks after copying back read localCard, not newCard; they are not a direct destination metadata oracle. Many existing assertions and vCardEqual calls omit messages.",
        "convertOnSave retains its useNewUID matrix and directly checks returned UID, stored properties and vCard UID. Autocomplete/header tests update setup calls; the basic API test only removes the obsolete method name from its coverage comment. No new assertion site is added, so setup/API execution should not be described as fresh copy/Windows/importer regression coverage.",
        "Read complete D278600 timeline and its one actual older-diff inline. Reviewer asks to document and clarify needToCopyCard; owned/current source applies withNewUID and concrete IDL guidance despite the inline's Not Done marker. The broad silly-name summary is local rationale, not a global naming rule. Sparse acceptance, historical remote successes/failure and landing are not fresh platform validation.",
